sources.citation: Dürr, Michael. 1987. A preliminary reconstruction of the Proto-Mixtec tonal system. Indiana 11: 19-61.
sources.note: Covers 17 published Mixtec dialects; San Miguel Piedras is not among them (no occurrence of 'Piedras'); irrelevant for this variety, kept for the record.

sources.citation: Lingmex: Bibliografía Lingüística de México desde 1970 (El Colegio de México), full-text search 'San Miguel Piedras' and 'Piedras mixteco' via the site's BusquedaSimple API, 2026-09-17
sources.note: Zero records on this variety (one unrelated Zapotec sociolinguistics thesis matched the phrase). CIESAS repository, Repositorio UNAM/TESIUNAM (only an ethnomusicology thesis on San Miguel Piedras string music, García López 2004), CrossRef, Zenodo, archive.org and Dialnet searches likewise returned no linguistic work.

sources.citation: Auderset, Sandra. 2024. MixteCoDB coding details ( in the MixteCoDB repository)
sources.note: Nothing on stress for this variety. Sec. 2.4.1 (p.14): Josserand 1983 data are wordlists in Americanist notation, conventions at Josserand 1983:472-474; Table 4 (p.15): San Miguel Piedras (pied11) has <5% of entries tone-marked, notation 'G' (grave).

sources.citation: Auderset, Sandra. 2024. MixteCoDB: Mixtecan cognate database (GitHub repository), + sources.bib
sources.note: Nothing; row SanMiguelPiedrasMixtec (Josserand code 'pied', Group 4 / Eastern Alta: Teozacoalco) lists SOURCE = josserand1983mixtec only, i.e. the only lexical data for this variety anywhere in the comparative literature is Josserand's 1983 wordlist.
